steps.npc: Hello there. Have you come to reflect?

steps.text: If the player's respawn point is not in Prifddinas:

steps.npc: It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can offer you the ability to respawn in Prifddinas upon death.
Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Prifddinas.
As you wish. I'll be here if you change your mind.

steps.text: If the player's respawn point is in Prifddinas:

steps.npc: It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
As you wish. If you ever tire of respawning in Prifddinas, just let me know.
